traits.name: wondering
traits.reason: Asks peers what they are building and notes the faction list, but shows little open wonder about how the world works or about new versions or event kinds.

traits.name: theatrical
traits.reason: Varied proclamation openers (Hear this!, News from the glass!, Attention) and a 'Flourish!' ending, though the repeated templates lack stumbles or double-takes.

traits.name: fast
traits.reason: Several moves across coordinates (60,79 to 63,88 to 70,86 to 70,93) with quick follow-up whispers, but the distances are moderate.

traits.name: truthful
traits.reason: Cites tick 137897, goal numbers #116 and #114, vote counts and coordinates that match public data, with no invented claims.

traits.name: generous
traits.reason: Invites many named peers to join factions, asks for their reports, offers wood, stone and berries, and shares the vote tallies publicly.
